headline: PM orders action after dog killed by tying brick to neck
summary: Two more suspects have been arrested following a horrific incident where a dog was tied with a brick and thrown from a bridge into a river.
details: A shocking video surfaced showing men tying a brick to a dog's neck before throwing it off a bridge into a river to kill it.
The Prime Minister has taken notice of the incident and ordered immediate legal action against those responsible for the cruelty.
Following the investigation, police have arrested two additional suspects involved in the crime.
The incident has sparked widespread outrage across the country, with many calling for strict punishment for animal cruelty.

headline: 191 killed in 7 months on Cumilla section of Dhaka-Chattogram highway
summary: The stretch of road has become a 'death trap', with nearly 200 lives lost in just over half a year.
details: The Cumilla section of the Dhaka-Chattogram highway has seen a staggering 191 deaths in the last seven months.
This high fatality rate has turned the stretch of road into a dangerous 'death trap' for commuters and drivers alike.
The highway is one of the busiest in the country, connecting two of the largest cities in Bangladesh.
Local authorities and commuters are calling for urgent measures to improve safety standards and reduce the accident rate.
